company_pages.title: Home - National Industries
company_pages.text:
Namibind is a trusted manufacturer and exporter of office automation machines including paper shredders, cash counting machines, binding, lamination, and cutting machines. Serving India and global markets with quality and innovation since 1990.

Our Quality: Conforming to global quality specifications, we make sure that all the products being traded in and supplied by us are according to the desired client requirements. We are bestowed with a panel of quality analysts, who independently inspect each and every product in order to avoid any kind of flaws in our product range. To guarantee that all the components traded in, are offered with higher performance levels, we mostly procure the products from consistent as well as trustworthy merchandisers.

Client Satisfaction: Being a client-centric company, all our activities are directed towards meeting the exact needs of our clients. We have been able to acquire a vast client-base just due to the painstaking labors and devotion levels of our workforce. They work in collaboration with our customers to better know their exact needs and deliver them a precise solution. Apart from this, we also facilitate our clients with simple payment modes to make the business process faster.

company_pages.title: Office Automation Systems - National Industries
company_pages.text:
Our portfolio encompasses Lamination Machines, Paper Shredder Machines, Binding Machines, Paper Cutting Machines, Currency Counting Machines and Paper Shredder Machine Rental Services. We are widely admired for our high quality products and services in the market.

Our Product Range:
- Heavy Duty Paper Shredder: A paper shredder machine is a vital tool for protecting sensitive information in both personal and professional needs. Whether you are a small business, corporate office, government department, educational institution, or industrial unit, Namibind offers a wide range of paper shredders to suit every shredding requirement. From compact models for desktop use to high-capacity industrial shredders, our machines are built for durability, safety, and performance. Each model is designed to destroy documents efficiently, ensuring secure disposal of confidential data and compliance with privacy regulations. For personal and office use, our small paper shredder machines and office use paper shredders are compact, user-friendly, and ideal for shredding daily paperwork, bills, emails, and other sensitive documents. These models are ideal for desk-side use and typically feature cross-cut or strip-cut functionality, offering basic to moderate levels of data protection. For enhanced security, our micro cut paper shredders deliver ultra-fine shredding ideal for financial, legal, or confidential business data. For businesses with heavier needs, our heavy-duty paper shredders and industrial paper shredder machines are capable of continuous operation and high-volume shredding. Built with powerful motors and durable blades, these models can shred thick stacks of paper, files, folders, CDs, credit cards, and even staples. Designed for long working hours, these machines come with features like jam-proof systems, overload protection, auto start/stop, and thermal shutdown. Namibind also offers specialized cardboard shredder machines designed to repurpose cardboard packaging into protective packaging material. These shredders are widely used in logistics, e-commerce, and manufacturing sectors where waste reduction and material recycling are key priorities. Whether you're managing large volumes of waste paper or need to protect sensitive information, our commercial paper shredders offer unmatched performance and reliability. With multiple shredding options, including strip cut, cross cut, and micro cut, Namibind ensures that customers can choose the right level of security based on their document destruction needs. All machines are built with a focus on energy efficiency, ease of use, and low maintenance. Our commitment to quality and innovation makes us a preferred choice for paper shredder machines in India and abroad.
- Currency Counting Machines: Namibind offers a full range of cash counting machines designed to simplify and speed up currency handling across retail stores, banks, offices, petrol pumps, hotels, supermarkets, and financial institutions. Whether you are counting loose notes, bundles, coins, or verifying fake currency, Namibind has a suitable solution for every cash management need. Built for accuracy, speed, and reliability, our machines help businesses save time, reduce manual effort, and eliminate human error. We provide loose note counting machines that are perfect for fast and accurate counting of mixed or sorted currency. These machines are widely used in cash-intensive environments where speed and convenience are essential. Equipped with intelligent sensors and user-friendly displays, these machines handle large volumes with minimal operator input. Our bundle note counting machines are designed for high-volume operations and can count full bundles of currency (typically 100 notes at a time) with high accuracy. Ideal for banks, currency chests, and large organizations, these machines ensure smooth, error-free counting of strapped note bundles. Some models also support fitness sorting and batch counting. For businesses that deal with unsorted or mixed denomination currency, Namibind offers mix value cash counting machines. These advanced machines can identify and calculate the total value of mixed notes, detect denomination-wise totals, and even print receipts. They are equipped with multi-currency support, serial number reading, and advanced detection technology, making them ideal for businesses that need accurate cash reconciliation. We also provide money counting machines with fake note detectors, which include built-in detection systems such as UV (ultraviolet), MG (magnetic), IR (infrared), and image detection. These features help identify counterfeit currency instantly during the counting process, ensuring secure transactions. For additional verification, we also supply UV lamp fake note detectors, a compact, easy-to-use tool for manually checking currency authenticity, used widely in retail and small businesses. Namibind also offers coin counting machines that are ideal for toll booths, vending operators, banks, and retail outlets. These machines can sort and count coins of different denominations accurately and quickly, saving hours of manual work. They are robust, easy to operate, and suitable for heavy-duty use.
- Thermal Lamination Machine: Namibind offers a comprehensive selection of thermal lamination machines designed to meet the diverse needs of businesses, educational institutions, printing presses, corporate offices, and industrial units. Whether you're looking for compact models for document lamination or high-speed roll-to-roll machines for industrial use, Namibind delivers quality, performance, and durability in every model. Our range includes roll to roll lamination machines that are ideal for high-volume operations. These machines are commonly used in the printing and packaging industries for laminating flex, posters, digital prints, and other large-format media. Built for continuous use, these models ensure consistent output, bubble-free lamination, and are suitable for both hot and cold lamination films. For businesses seeking automation and efficiency, our autocut lamination machines and autofeed lamination machines offer time-saving benefits by automatically feeding and cutting sheets post-lamination. These machines are best suited for bulk lamination work such as brochures, certificates, book covers, and product packaging. They increase productivity while reducing manual effort and errors, making them an excellent investment for commercial printing businesses and packaging units. Namibind also provides pouch lamination machines for offices, schools, and personal use. These machines are perfect for laminating ID cards, documents, certificates, photographs, and licenses. They are compact, easy to use, and provide high-quality lamination using thermal pouches of various sizes and thicknesses. Similarly, our document lamination machines and paper lamination machines cater to general-purpose lamination needs and come with precise heat and speed control for various paper types and finishes. Each Namibind lamination machine is engineered for durability and ease of use. With features like temperature control, adjustable speed, pressure rollers, anti-curl mechanisms, and auto shut-off functions, our machines are suitable for light-duty as well as heavy-duty lamination tasks. We focus on user safety, energy efficiency, and consistent performance across all models. Whether you need a high-speed lamination machine for industrial-grade jobs or a compact desktop laminator for everyday use.
- Spiral Binding Machines: Namibind offers a complete range of Spiral Binding Machines, also known as Coil Binding Machines, suitable for various binding needs across schools, offices, commercial printing presses, and corporate institutions. Our machines are designed to deliver clean, professional, and secure document binding with the flexibility to use both plastic and metal coils. Whether you're looking for a compact manual binding machine for light usage or a heavy-duty spiral binder for large-scale binding operations, we have it all under one roof. Our product lineup includes standard manual spiral binding machines, heavy-duty spiral binders built for industrial-level workloads, as well as electric spiral binding machines with automatic coil inserters that simplify the binding process and significantly boost productivity. For advanced users, we also offer multi-die changeable binding machines, which allow you to switch between spiral, comb, and wire binding dies, making the machine highly versatile and ideal for print shops and service centers with high-volume and diverse binding requirements. Additionally, we provide specialized spiral binding machines with electric coil inserters that automatically spin the binding coil through the punched holes, saving time and ensuring a tight, secure finish. These machines are particularly useful for bulk jobs and commercial printing environments. Each machine is built with a durable metal body, precision punching dies, and adjustable margin settings to provide the best binding quality. Namibind is not just a supplier; we are a leading Indian manufacturer with a strong presence across the country. Our pan-India dealer and service network ensures prompt support, spare availability, and hands-on training wherever needed. We also stock and supply all necessary binding consumables, including spiral binding rings (also known as spico), binding covers, and accessories, making us a one-stop destination for all your document binding needs. With years of experience in the binding industry, we understand what professionals need and deliver machines that are user-friendly, robust, and built to last.
- Paper Cutting Machine: Namibind offers a wide and advanced range of paper cutting machines designed for precision, durability, and performance across various industries. Whether you are running a print house, publishing unit, packaging business, or stationery production, we provide cutting solutions that suit every scale of operation—from manual setups to fully automated systems. Our paper cutters are trusted across India for their accuracy, long lifespan, and ease of use. Our range includes hydraulic paper cutting machines designed for industrial applications where continuous heavy-duty cutting is required. These machines use a hydraulic pressure system to cut thick stacks of paper with ease and high precision. They are best suited for large-scale print industries, packaging plants, and commercial printing presses. Known for their robustness and consistency, these machines reduce operator fatigue and enhance production efficiency. We also provide semi-automatic paper cutting machines, ideal for medium-volume operations. These models combine manual feeding with automated clamping and cutting systems. They are suitable for print shops, bookbinding units, and government departments where regular paper cutting is needed without the need for fully programmable systems. They offer a balance between cost-efficiency and performance. For advanced requirements, Namibind offers programmable paper cutting machines and digital paper cutting machines with touch screen control panels, memory functions, and automatic back gauge movement. These machines are built for speed, accuracy, and repeatability, allowing operators to store multiple cutting programs for faster execution. These models are highly recommended for high-precision jobs such as cutting brochures, invitation cards, labels, visiting cards, and other fine print media. With features like infrared safety sensors, auto clamp pressure adjustment, and precise positioning accuracy, these machines improve safety and productivity. All Namibind cutting machines are made with high-quality steel bodies, durable blades, and easy-to-maintain mechanisms. They are available in various cutting widths, heights, and formats to suit different paper sizes and workloads. Whether you need a basic cutter for daily use or a sophisticated programmable model for commercial mass production, Namibind ensures you get the right solution tailored to your business needs.
- Binding Machine: We offer a complete range of professional book binding machines tailored for offices, printing presses, schools, publishers, and documentation centers. From wiro binding machines to die-changeable systems and velo binding machines, our range is built to meet different levels of binding needs from basic document finishing to heavy-duty commercial usage. Our wiro binding machines are designed for efficient punching and binding using metal wire spines. We provide both 2:1 pitch (ideal for thicker documents) and 3:1 pitch (for thinner sheets) wiro binding machines. The 2:1 wiro binding machine is widely used for notebooks, calendars, and reports requiring a sturdy hold, while the 3:1 machine offers finer, denser punching patterns for a professional finish on smaller-sized books or presentations. For operations requiring flexibility, we also offer die-changeable wiro binding machines that allow users to switch between punching patterns quickly, a perfect solution for print shops managing varied customer requirements.

For precision cutting of wire spools, we offer wiro cutting machines, which are robust and reliable, designed to trim wires cleanly to your required binding sizes. To complement this, our wiro closer machines help in securely closing the wire around the punched pages, ensuring a neat and durable bind. These machines are easy to operate and ideal for bulk operations where speed and accuracy matter. In addition to wire binding, we also provide a complete solution for velo binding, which is ideal for official documentation, legal files, and secured reports. Our range includes Velo Binding Machine System 1 for light to medium use and Velo Binding Machine V30, a heavy-duty version built for bulk binding jobs. These machines use secure plastic strips and pins to permanently bind pages, offering a tamper-proof solution perfect for offices and government institutions. All our machines come with solid metal construction, precision punching pins, margin and depth adjustment features, and smooth operating levers or electric options (depending on the model). Whether you are looking for a manual, semi-electric, or fully electric system, our wiro and velo binding machines are built to deliver high performance with minimal maintenance. With strong after-sales support, availability of spare parts, and PAN India service network.
- Comb Binding Machines: Namibind is a leading manufacturer and supplier of all types of comb binding machines and accessories in India. Our comprehensive range includes manual comb binding machines, heavy-duty comb binding machines, and electric comb binding machines, suitable for schools, offices, printing shops, government departments, and commercial setups. Designed for ease of use, durability, and long-term performance, Namibind binding machines are trusted nationwide for document binding and report finishing tasks. Our machines use comb binding rings (also known as spico rings)—available in multiple sizes and colors, to securely bind documents, reports, presentations, and booklets. These plastic binding combs are reusable, economical, and allow the document to open flat for easy reading or photocopying. They are compatible with all standard comb binding machines and ideal for binding anywhere from 10 to 500 sheets depending on the comb size. The manual comb binding machines offered by Namibind are perfect for regular office use, small print jobs, or educational institutions. These models are designed with ergonomic punching handles, adjustable margin settings, and durable steel punching dies to ensure smooth operation. For more demanding environments, we offer heavy-duty comb binding machines capable of handling higher volumes and thicker documents with ease. These are ideal for publishing houses, document finishing centers, and large offices. For businesses looking for increased efficiency and productivity, Namibind also manufactures electric comb binding machines. These models automate the punching process while offering manual or automatic comb opening and binding options. They are ideal for organizations handling bulk document binding regularly and are built for long operating hours with minimal maintenance. As a reputed manufacturer of all types of binding machines, Namibind ensures each product goes through strict quality control checks and is built using premium-grade components for long-term durability. We also provide comb binding consumables (rings/spico) in bulk, along with a complete range of spare parts and accessories.
- Waste Shredder: We are a leading manufacturer and supplier of a comprehensive range of waste shredding machines designed to meet diverse industrial and commercial needs. Our portfolio includes paper waste shredders, plastic waste shredders, PET bottle shredders, hard disk shredders, garden waste shredders, and organic waste shredders. Among these, our hard drive shredder machines are specially engineered to offer high-security destruction of sensitive digital data. With the growing demand for data protection, our hard disk shredders provide complete physical destruction of hard drives, SSDs, CDs, DVDs, USBs, and other digital storage devices, ensuring irreversible data removal. These machines are compact yet robust and are widely used by data centers, corporate offices, financial institutions, government organizations, and recycling units. In addition to digital media destruction, we also manufacture highly efficient plastic waste shredders and PET bottle crushers, essential for recycling industries dealing with packaging waste and single-use plastics. Our machines are designed to handle both light-duty and heavy-duty loads, depending on the client's requirement. The PET bottle crushers are equipped with high-torque cutting blades that reduce bottles into recyclable flakes, ideal for reuse in plastic processing. For environmental sustainability and agricultural needs, we offer garden and organic waste shredders, capable of processing leaves, branches, food waste, and biodegradable materials into compostable chips or mulch. These shredders are suitable for municipal waste management and large-scale composting operations. Whether it’s paper, plastic, metal, or organic material, our waste shredding solutions deliver reliable performance, ease of operation, and long service life. We support our machines with strong after-sales service and a nationwide dealer network. Each machine is built with a focus on safety, efficiency, and durability, making us a trusted choice for industries seeking effective and secure waste management solutions.
- Half Sticker Cutting Machine: We offer a complete range of half sticker cutting machines and vinyl cutting plotters, designed to meet the growing needs of signage professionals, advertising agencies, packaging businesses, and printing firms. Whether you’re looking for a machine to create precise half-cuts on label sheets or full-cut vinyl designs for signage, we have you covered with our wide selection of high-performance, durable machines. Our inventory includes all types of vinyl cutting plotter machines, including trusted models from Skycut and Saga, which are known for their precision, smooth operation, and compatibility with various design software. These machines are capable of handling various materials such as PVC vinyl, reflective sheets, PET, stickers, and heat transfer films. For advanced commercial use, we also offer dual head cutting plotter machines that increase efficiency and reduce production time. These machines are ideal for large-scale operations that require both kiss cutting (half cutting) and full cutting in a single workflow. Our half cutting plotters are specifically designed to ensure that only the top layer of the sticker sheet is cut without damaging the backing paper, making them perfect for label production and packaging industries. On the other hand, our full cutting plotters are capable of slicing through materials entirely for custom shape designs, tags, and product labels. We also offer label sticker cutting machines that are ideal for batch production of product stickers, barcodes, and QR labels in both small and large formats. Each machine comes with features like touchscreen control panels, ARMS sensor technology for accurate contour cutting, high-speed stepper or servo motors, and adjustable cutting force and speed. Whether you require a compact machine for office or retail use or a heavy-duty model for industrial-scale operations, our range ensures there's a model that fits your needs and budget. As manufacturers and suppliers, we provide pan India service support, genuine machine parts, prompt installation, and training assistance. Our commitment is not just to supply machines but to offer complete support that enhances your productivity and workflow. Whether you're starting a new business or upgrading your existing equipment, our vinyl and sticker cutting solutions are built to deliver reliable performance, accuracy, and long-term value.
- Electronic Safe: Explore our range of Electronic Safe with 21 featured products.
- Glue Binding Machine: We are a trusted manufacturer and supplier of a wide range of glue binding machines that cater to the diverse needs of publishers, print houses, office setups, educational institutions, and document binding businesses. Our glue binding solutions include desktop automatic glue binding machines, desktop perfect book binding machines, semi-automatic glue binding machines, and manual glue binders, all available in both A4 and A3 size configurations. These machines are designed for ease of use, durability, and professional finish, ensuring strong binding with minimal effort and maximum output.

Our desktop automatic glue binding machines offer a complete binding solution with automatic spine gluing, cover clamping, and pressing features. Ideal for fast-paced office environments and print shops, these machines ensure high-speed binding with consistent quality. Their compact design makes them suitable even for small workspaces without compromising performance. We also offer desktop perfect book binding machines, which are widely used for binding softcover books, reports, catalogs, manuals, and journals. Available in both manual and semi-automatic variants, these machines are known for their precision and neat finishing. The manual perfect binding machines are perfect for low to medium volume binding tasks and provide strong adhesive bonding through heated glue rollers. Our semi-automatic glue binding machines combine the flexibility of manual operation with automated gluing and pressing features, making them a cost-effective and efficient choice for medium to high-volume binding needs. Whether you need a machine for A4-sized books or larger A3 formats, we have models specifically designed to accommodate various paper sizes and thickness levels. All our glue binding machines are built using robust components, quality heating systems, and adjustable clamps to ensure maximum binding strength. These machines support EVA hot melt glue and PUR glue, depending on model, and ensure fast warm-up times and high binding capacity per hour. With user-friendly control panels and safety features, our machines are easy to operate and maintain. Whether you're a startup or an established print facility, our range of glue binding machines ensures high efficiency, strong binding quality, and long-term reliability.
- Laminating Roll Film: We offer a premium range of lamination film rolls that provide superior protection, enhanced appearance, and increased durability for all your printed materials. Whether you're laminating documents, posters, brochures, photos, or packaging materials, our lamination rolls ensure a smooth, glossy, or matte finish with excellent clarity and adhesion. Our collection includes cold lamination film rolls, hot lamination film rolls, thermal lamination film rolls, and jumbo lamination rolls to suit every application—manual, semi-automatic, or automatic lamination machines. The cold lamination film rolls are ideal for heat-sensitive media, photo prints, inkjet outputs, or surfaces that may get damaged by high temperatures. These pressure-sensitive films come with a strong adhesive backing that sticks firmly to the surface without the need for heat, making them perfect for signage, decals, or short-run jobs. Our hot lamination film rolls are designed for use with thermal lamination machines and offer a stronger bond and glossier appearance. These films melt and bind with the surface of paper using heat and pressure, making them ideal for book covers, menus, ID cards, certificates, marketing materials, and more. We offer both glossy and matte finishes to match your aesthetic needs. We also provide thermal lamination film rolls, including BOPP thermal lamination rolls and PET thermal films, which work seamlessly with a wide range of roll-to-roll lamination machines. These are widely used for commercial lamination applications due to their fast application, high bond strength, and superior finish. Thermal films are available in multiple thickness options (18 microns, 24 microns, 27 microns, 32 microns, etc.) and finishes like gloss, matte, velvet, soft-touch, and digital-grade. Our jumbo lamination rolls are perfect for high-volume operations and industrial lamination machines. These rolls offer cost efficiency, fewer roll changes, and long, uninterrupted production runs. Available in large widths (12", 13", 18", 24", 36", 42", etc.) and lengths, they are ideal for print houses, packaging plants, and commercial printing units.

sections.text: Namibind offers a comprehensive selection of thermal lamination machines designed to meet the diverse needs of businesses, educational institutions, printing presses, corporate offices, and industrial units. Whether you're looking for compact models for document lamination or high-speed roll-to-roll machines for industrial use, Namibind delivers quality, performance, and durability in every model. Our range includes roll to roll lamination machines that are ideal for high-volume operations. These machines are commonly used in the printing and packaging industries for laminating flex, posters, digital prints, and other large-format media. Built for continuous use, these models ensure consistent output, bubble-free lamination, and are suitable for both hot and cold lamination films. For businesses seeking automation and efficiency, our autocut lamination machines and autofeed lamination machines offer time-saving benefits by automatically feeding and cutting sheets post-lamination. These machines are best suited for bulk lamination work such as brochures, certificates, book covers, and product packaging. They increase productivity while reducing manual effort and errors, making them an excellent investment for commercial printing businesses and packaging units. Namibind also provides pouch lamination machines for offices, schools, and personal use. These machines are perfect for laminating ID cards, documents, certificates, photographs, and licenses. They are compact, easy to use, and provide high-quality lamination using thermal pouches of various sizes and thicknesses. Similarly, our document lamination machines and paper lamination machines cater to general-purpose lamination needs and come with precise heat and speed control for various paper types and finishes. Each Namibind lamination machine is engineered for durability and ease of use. With features like temperature control, adjustable speed, pressure rollers, anti-curl mechanisms, and auto shut-off functions, our machines are suitable for light-duty as well as heavy-duty lamination tasks. We focus on user safety, energy efficiency, and consistent performance across all models. Whether you need a high-speed lamination machine for industrial-grade jobs or a compact desktop laminator for everyday use.

sections.title: Spiral Binding Machines
sections.text: Namibind offers a complete range of Spiral Binding Machines, also known as Coil Binding Machines, suitable for various binding needs across schools, offices, commercial printing presses, and corporate institutions. Our machines are designed to deliver clean, professional, and secure document binding with the flexibility to use both plastic and metal coils. Whether you're looking for a compact manual binding machine for light usage or a heavy-duty spiral binder for large-scale binding operations, we have it all under one roof. Our product lineup includes standard manual spiral binding machines, heavy-duty spiral binders built for industrial-level workloads, as well as electric spiral binding machines with automatic coil inserters that simplify the binding process and significantly boost productivity. For advanced users, we also offer multi-die changeable binding machines, which allow you to switch between spiral, comb, and wire binding dies, making the machine highly versatile and ideal for print shops and service centers with high-volume and diverse binding requirements. Additionally, we provide specialized spiral binding machines with electric coil inserters that automatically spin the binding coil through the punched holes, saving time and ensuring a tight, secure finish. These machines are particularly useful for bulk jobs and commercial printing environments. Each machine is built with a durable metal body, precision punching dies, and adjustable margin settings to provide the best binding quality. Namibind is not just a supplier; we are a leading Indian manufacturer with a strong presence across the country. Our pan-India dealer and service network ensures prompt support, spare availability, and hands-on training wherever needed. We also stock and supply all necessary binding consumables, including spiral binding rings (also known as spico), binding covers, and accessories, making us a one-stop destination for all your document binding needs. With years of experience in the binding industry, we understand what professionals need and deliver machines that are user-friendly, robust, and built to last.

sections.title: Paper Cutting Machine
sections.text: Namibind offers a wide and advanced range of paper cutting machines designed for precision, durability, and performance across various industries. Whether you are running a print house, publishing unit, packaging business, or stationery production, we provide cutting solutions that suit every scale of operation—from manual setups to fully automated systems. Our paper cutters are trusted across India for their accuracy, long lifespan, and ease of use. Our range includes hydraulic paper cutting machines designed for industrial applications where continuous heavy-duty cutting is required. These machines use a hydraulic pressure system to cut thick stacks of paper with ease and high precision. They are best suited for large-scale print industries, packaging plants, and commercial printing presses. Known for their robustness and consistency, these machines reduce operator fatigue and enhance production efficiency. We also provide semi-automatic paper cutting machines, ideal for medium-volume operations. These models combine manual feeding with automated clamping and cutting systems. They are suitable for print shops, bookbinding units, and government departments where regular paper cutting is needed without the need for fully programmable systems. They offer a balance between cost-efficiency and performance. For advanced requirements, Namibind offers programmable paper cutting machines and digital paper cutting machines with touch screen control panels, memory functions, and automatic back gauge movement. These machines are built for speed, accuracy, and repeatability, allowing operators to store multiple cutting programs for faster execution. These models are highly recommended for high-precision jobs such as cutting brochures, invitation cards, labels, visiting cards, and other fine print media. With features like infrared safety sensors, auto clamp pressure adjustment, and precise positioning accuracy, these machines improve safety and productivity. All Namibind cutting machines are made with high-quality steel bodies, durable blades, and easy-to-maintain mechanisms. They are available in various cutting widths, heights, and formats to suit different paper sizes and workloads. Whether you need a basic cutter for daily use or a sophisticated programmable model for commercial mass production, Namibind ensures you get the right solution tailored to your business needs.

sections.title: Binding Machine
sections.text:
We offer a complete range of professional book binding machines tailored for offices, printing presses, schools, publishers, and documentation centers. From wiro binding machines to die-changeable systems and velo binding machines, our range is built to meet different levels of binding needs from basic document finishing to heavy-duty commercial usage. Our wiro binding machines are designed for efficient punching and binding using metal wire spines. We provide both 2:1 pitch (ideal for thicker documents) and 3:1 pitch (for thinner sheets) wiro binding machines. The 2:1 wiro binding machine is widely used for notebooks, calendars, and reports requiring a sturdy hold, while the 3:1 machine offers finer, denser punching patterns for a professional finish on smaller-sized books or presentations. For operations requiring flexibility, we also offer die-changeable wiro binding machines that allow users to switch between punching patterns quickly, a perfect solution for print shops managing varied customer requirements.

For precision cutting of wire spools, we offer wiro cutting machines, which are robust and reliable, designed to trim wires cleanly to your required binding sizes. To complement this, our wiro closer machines help in securely closing the wire around the punched pages, ensuring a neat and durable bind. These machines are easy to operate and ideal for bulk operations where speed and accuracy matter. In addition to wire binding, we also provide a complete solution for velo binding, which is ideal for official documentation, legal files, and secured reports. Our range includes Velo Binding Machine System 1 for light to medium use and Velo Binding Machine V30, a heavy-duty version built for bulk binding jobs. These machines use secure plastic strips and pins to permanently bind pages, offering a tamper-proof solution perfect for offices and government institutions. All our machines come with solid metal construction, precision punching pins, margin and depth adjustment features, and smooth operating levers or electric options (depending on the model). Whether you are looking for a manual, semi-electric, or fully electric system, our wiro and velo binding machines are built to deliver high performance with minimal maintenance. With strong after-sales support, availability of spare parts, and PAN India service network.

sections.title: Comb Binding Machines
sections.text: Namibind is a leading manufacturer and supplier of all types of comb binding machines and accessories in India. Our comprehensive range includes manual comb binding machines, heavy-duty comb binding machines, and electric comb binding machines, suitable for schools, offices, printing shops, government departments, and commercial setups. Designed for ease of use, durability, and long-term performance, Namibind binding machines are trusted nationwide for document binding and report finishing tasks. Our machines use comb binding rings (also known as spico rings)—available in multiple sizes and colors, to securely bind documents, reports, presentations, and booklets. These plastic binding combs are reusable, economical, and allow the document to open flat for easy reading or photocopying. They are compatible with all standard comb binding machines and ideal for binding anywhere from 10 to 500 sheets depending on the comb size. The manual comb binding machines offered by Namibind are perfect for regular office use, small print jobs, or educational institutions. These models are designed with ergonomic punching handles, adjustable margin settings, and durable steel punching dies to ensure smooth operation. For more demanding environments, we offer heavy-duty comb binding machines capable of handling higher volumes and thicker documents with ease. These are ideal for publishing houses, document finishing centers, and large offices. For businesses looking for increased efficiency and productivity, Namibind also manufactures electric comb binding machines. These models automate the punching process while offering manual or automatic comb opening and binding options. They are ideal for organizations handling bulk document binding regularly and are built for long operating hours with minimal maintenance. As a reputed manufacturer of all types of binding machines, Namibind ensures each product goes through strict quality control checks and is built using premium-grade components for long-term durability. We also provide comb binding consumables (rings/spico) in bulk, along with a complete range of spare parts and accessories.

sections.title: Waste Shredder
sections.text: We are a leading manufacturer and supplier of a comprehensive range of waste shredding machines designed to meet diverse industrial and commercial needs. Our portfolio includes paper waste shredders, plastic waste shredders, PET bottle shredders, hard disk shredders, garden waste shredders, and organic waste shredders. Among these, our hard drive shredder machines are specially engineered to offer high-security destruction of sensitive digital data. With the growing demand for data protection, our hard disk shredders provide complete physical destruction of hard drives, SSDs, CDs, DVDs, USBs, and other digital storage devices, ensuring irreversible data removal. These machines are compact yet robust and are widely used by data centers, corporate offices, financial institutions, government organizations, and recycling units. In addition to digital media destruction, we also manufacture highly efficient plastic waste shredders and PET bottle crushers, essential for recycling industries dealing with packaging waste and single-use plastics. Our machines are designed to handle both light-duty and heavy-duty loads, depending on the client's requirement. The PET bottle crushers are equipped with high-torque cutting blades that reduce bottles into recyclable flakes, ideal for reuse in plastic processing. For environmental sustainability and agricultural needs, we offer garden and organic waste shredders, capable of processing leaves, branches, food waste, and biodegradable materials into compostable chips or mulch. These shredders are suitable for municipal waste management and large-scale composting operations. Whether it’s paper, plastic, metal, or organic material, our waste shredding solutions deliver reliable performance, ease of operation, and long service life. We support our machines with strong after-sales service and a nationwide dealer network. Each machine is built with a focus on safety, efficiency, and durability, making us a trusted choice for industries seeking effective and secure waste management solutions.

sections.title: Half Sticker Cutting Machine
sections.text: We offer a complete range of half sticker cutting machines and vinyl cutting plotters, designed to meet the growing needs of signage professionals, advertising agencies, packaging businesses, and printing firms. Whether you’re looking for a machine to create precise half-cuts on label sheets or full-cut vinyl designs for signage, we have you covered with our wide selection of high-performance, durable machines. Our inventory includes all types of vinyl cutting plotter machines, including trusted models from Skycut and Saga, which are known for their precision, smooth operation, and compatibility with various design software. These machines are capable of handling various materials such as PVC vinyl, reflective sheets, PET, stickers, and heat transfer films. For advanced commercial use, we also offer dual head cutting plotter machines that increase efficiency and reduce production time. These machines are ideal for large-scale operations that require both kiss cutting (half cutting) and full cutting in a single workflow. Our half cutting plotters are specifically designed to ensure that only the top layer of the sticker sheet is cut without damaging the backing paper, making them perfect for label production and packaging industries. On the other hand, our full cutting plotters are capable of slicing through materials entirely for custom shape designs, tags, and product labels. We also offer label sticker cutting machines that are ideal for batch production of product stickers, barcodes, and QR labels in both small and large formats. Each machine comes with features like touchscreen control panels, ARMS sensor technology for accurate contour cutting, high-speed stepper or servo motors, and adjustable cutting force and speed. Whether you require a compact machine for office or retail use or a heavy-duty model for industrial-scale operations, our range ensures there's a model that fits your needs and budget. As manufacturers and suppliers, we provide pan India service support, genuine machine parts, prompt installation, and training assistance. Our commitment is not just to supply machines but to offer complete support that enhances your productivity and workflow. Whether you're starting a new business or upgrading your existing equipment, our vinyl and sticker cutting solutions are built to deliver reliable performance, accuracy, and long-term value.

sections.title: Glue Binding Machine
sections.text:
We are a trusted manufacturer and supplier of a wide range of glue binding machines that cater to the diverse needs of publishers, print houses, office setups, educational institutions, and document binding businesses. Our glue binding solutions include desktop automatic glue binding machines, desktop perfect book binding machines, semi-automatic glue binding machines, and manual glue binders, all available in both A4 and A3 size configurations. These machines are designed for ease of use, durability, and professional finish, ensuring strong binding with minimal effort and maximum output.

Our desktop automatic glue binding machines offer a complete binding solution with automatic spine gluing, cover clamping, and pressing features. Ideal for fast-paced office environments and print shops, these machines ensure high-speed binding with consistent quality. Their compact design makes them suitable even for small workspaces without compromising performance. We also offer desktop perfect book binding machines, which are widely used for binding softcover books, reports, catalogs, manuals, and journals. Available in both manual and semi-automatic variants, these machines are known for their precision and neat finishing. The manual perfect binding machines are perfect for low to medium volume binding tasks and provide strong adhesive bonding through heated glue rollers. Our semi-automatic glue binding machines combine the flexibility of manual operation with automated gluing and pressing features, making them a cost-effective and efficient choice for medium to high-volume binding needs. Whether you need a machine for A4-sized books or larger A3 formats, we have models specifically designed to accommodate various paper sizes and thickness levels. All our glue binding machines are built using robust components, quality heating systems, and adjustable clamps to ensure maximum binding strength. These machines support EVA hot melt glue and PUR glue, depending on model, and ensure fast warm-up times and high binding capacity per hour. With user-friendly control panels and safety features, our machines are easy to operate and maintain. Whether you're a startup or an established print facility, our range of glue binding machines ensures high efficiency, strong binding quality, and long-term reliability.

sections.title: Laminating Roll Film
sections.text: We offer a premium range of lamination film rolls that provide superior protection, enhanced appearance, and increased durability for all your printed materials. Whether you're laminating documents, posters, brochures, photos, or packaging materials, our lamination rolls ensure a smooth, glossy, or matte finish with excellent clarity and adhesion. Our collection includes cold lamination film rolls, hot lamination film rolls, thermal lamination film rolls, and jumbo lamination rolls to suit every application—manual, semi-automatic, or automatic lamination machines. The cold lamination film rolls are ideal for heat-sensitive media, photo prints, inkjet outputs, or surfaces that may get damaged by high temperatures. These pressure-sensitive films come with a strong adhesive backing that sticks firmly to the surface without the need for heat, making them perfect for signage, decals, or short-run jobs. Our hot lamination film rolls are designed for use with thermal lamination machines and offer a stronger bond and glossier appearance. These films melt and bind with the surface of paper using heat and pressure, making them ideal for book covers, menus, ID cards, certificates, marketing materials, and more. We offer both glossy and matte finishes to match your aesthetic needs. We also provide thermal lamination film rolls, including BOPP thermal lamination rolls and PET thermal films, which work seamlessly with a wide range of roll-to-roll lamination machines. These are widely used for commercial lamination applications due to their fast application, high bond strength, and superior finish. Thermal films are available in multiple thickness options (18 microns, 24 microns, 27 microns, 32 microns, etc.) and finishes like gloss, matte, velvet, soft-touch, and digital-grade. Our jumbo lamination rolls are perfect for high-volume operations and industrial lamination machines. These rolls offer cost efficiency, fewer roll changes, and long, uninterrupted production runs. Available in large widths (12", 13", 18", 24", 36", 42", etc.) and lengths, they are ideal for print houses, packaging plants, and commercial printing units.

company_pages.title: About Us - National Industries
company_pages.text: Namibind is a leading manufacturer and exporter of industrial and office automation machines in India, with over three decades of trusted experience in delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance solutions to businesses across sectors. Established in 1990 under the banner of National Industries, Namibind has emerged as a household name in office equipment, paper processing machinery, and document finishing solutions. We take pride in offering a diverse product portfolio that includes paper shredding machines, paper cutting machines, currency counting machines, book binding machines, lamination machines (both hot and cold lamination types), thermal binding covers, barcode and ID card cutters, comb and wire binding machines, industrial chippers, wood shredders, sawdust making machines, and more. Our machines are designed to meet the evolving needs of offices, print shops, publishers, educational institutions, packaging units, and government sectors. Our infrastructure comprises a modern manufacturing facility equipped with the latest tools and CNC machinery to ensure precision, durability, and quality in every machine we build. Every product undergoes rigorous quality checks and testing to match national and international performance standards. Our commitment to "Make in India" reflects in our in-house R&D, innovation-driven approach, and continued investment in developing advanced, user-friendly machines. Namibind serves customers not only across India but also in countries like UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Cambodia, Nigeria, and Tanzania, strengthening our footprint in international markets through trust, service, and performance. Our product range is continuously expanding to meet customer demands and technology trends. In addition to traditional automation products, we also offer a dedicated section for sublimation and creative printing equipment. This includes vinyl sticker cutting plotters, t-shirt printing sublimation machines, mug printing machines, eyelet punching machines, badge-making machines, and more – ideal for startup ventures, digital printing setups, and promotional businesses. Namibind actively participates in major trade exhibitions and industrial expos across India to stay connected with our customers and showcase our innovations. We have been part of renowned expos in Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Indore, Bengaluru, and other leading industrial hubs, allowing us to present our latest machines and gather direct customer feedback. Our vision is to be the most preferred brand in office and industrial automation by offering high-quality products backed by unmatched service and support. With dedicated service centers, an expert technical support team, and a strong dealer network, we ensure seamless post-sales experience and satisfaction for our clients. At Namibind, we don’t just sell machines, we deliver value, trust, and a partnership to help your business grow. Whether you're setting up a new printing unit, upgrading your office machinery, or automating an industrial process, Namibind offers you the right solution with the right support. Explore our complete range of high-performance machines and join thousands of satisfied customers who trust Namibind for quality, reliability, and performance.

Our Quality
Conforming to global quality specifications, we make sure that all the products being traded in and supplied by us are according to the desired client requirements. We are bestowed with a panel of quality analysts, who independently inspect each and every product in order to avoid any kind of flaws in our product range. To guarantee that all the components traded in, are offered with higher performance levels, we mostly procure the products from consistent as well as trustworthy merchandisers.

Client Satisfaction
Being a client-centric company, all our activities are directed towards meeting the exact needs of our clients. We have been able to acquire a vast client-base just due to the painstaking labors and devotion levels of our workforce. They work in collaboration with our customers to better know their exact needs and deliver them a precise solution. Apart from this, we also facilitate our clients with simple payment modes to make the business process faster.

About Us
Namibind is a leading manufacturer and exporter of industrial and office automation machines in India, with over three decades of trusted experience in delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance solutions to businesses across sectors. Established in 1990 under the banner of National Industries, Namibind has emerged as a household name in office equipment, paper processing machinery, and document finishing solutions. We take pride in offering a diverse product portfolio that includes paper shredding machines, paper cutting machines, currency counting machines, book binding machines, lamination machines (both hot and cold lamination types), thermal binding covers, barcode and ID card cutters, comb and wire binding machines, industrial chippers, wood shredders, sawdust making machines, and more. Our machines are designed to meet the evolving needs of offices, print shops, publishers, educational institutions, packaging units, and government sectors. Our infrastructure comprises a modern manufacturing facility equipped with the latest tools and CNC machinery to ensure precision, durability, and quality in every machine we build. Every product undergoes rigorous quality checks and testing to match national and international performance standards. Our commitment to "Make in India" reflects in our in-house R&D, innovation-driven approach, and continued investment in developing advanced, user-friendly machines. Namibind serves customers not only across India but also in countries like UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Cambodia, Nigeria, and Tanzania, strengthening our footprint in international markets through trust, service, and performance. Our product range is continuously expanding to meet customer demands and technology trends. In addition to traditional automation products, we also offer a dedicated section for sublimation and creative printing equipment. This includes vinyl sticker cutting plotters, t-shirt printing sublimation machines, mug printing machines, eyelet punching machines, badge-making machines, and more – ideal for startup ventures, digital printing setups, and promotional businesses. Namibind actively participates in major trade exhibitions and industrial expos across India to stay connected with our customers and showcase our innovations. We have been part of renowned expos in Delhi, Chennai, Kolkata, Indore, Bengaluru, and other leading industrial hubs, allowing us to present our latest machines and gather direct customer feedback. Our vision is to be the most preferred brand in office and industrial automation by offering high-quality products backed by unmatched service and support. With dedicated service centers, an expert technical support team, and a strong dealer network, we ensure seamless post-sales experience and satisfaction for our clients. At Namibind, we don’t just sell machines, we deliver value, trust, and a partnership to help your business grow. Whether you're setting up a new printing unit, upgrading your office machinery, or automating an industrial process, Namibind offers you the right solution with the right support. products.description:
Description
A shrink tunnel or heat tunnel is a heated tunnel mounted over or around a conveyor system. Items (such as packaging) have shrink film loosely applied; with heat, the film shrinks to fit snugly around the wrapped object. A shrink tunnel (also commonly known as a heat tunnel) is a metallic tunnel that sits above or is built around a conveyor. The tunnel has a heating element that heats the products as they move through the machine. Your products are conveyed through the tunnel and are cloaked with loosely fitting shrink film.

Single hole punches are often used to punch a ticket, which indicates it has been used, or to make confetti when creating scrapbooks and other paper crafts. For applications needing a variety of hole shapes, a ticket punch may be used. A single hole punch differs from a ticket punch in having a shorter reach and no choice of hole shape.

In the United States, single hole punches are often used to punch holes through playing cards, marking them as "used" or "canceled". This helps cut down on cheating by eliminating any cards that may have been tainted by players. Paper drilling is also popular for this purpose.

Single hole punches are widely used in the UK Civil Service where papers are punched with a single hole in the upper left, and secured using a treasury tag.

Namibind E-Waste recycling and data destruction are some of the fastest growing segments in the Information Destruction industry with the increased demand for digitization. More companies and individuals place sensitive information onto their hard drives, solid-state drives, mobile devices, and more, and more people seek the complete destruction of that information once the device’s use has run its course. CELL PHONE SHREDDING

Cell phone shredding is an excellent way to protect your private information. Phones can store and carry a lot of personal and confidential information, and one of the most reliable methods of ensuring that that information doesn’t get into the wrong hands is by completely destroying the phone using a shredder machine. It doesn’t take much for scammers, hackers, and thieves to access your phone’s sensitive data. Much of this information is stored within the phone, and methods such as factory resetting or formatting the phone have proven to not be a foolproof way to completely wipe all of that data from the phone. Industrial shredders are engineered to effectively destroy the phone and its data, making them an excellent way to protect personal information.

products.description:
NB 20 Drum Chipper Machine is a heavy-duty industrial wood chipping solution designed for high-volume biomass processing, forestry operations, and sawmill waste management . Built with a robust drum rotor system and powered by a 40 HP direct V-belt drive , this machine delivers consistent, high-output chipping performance for demanding industrial environments. With a 20-inch hopper opening and the ability to process wood up to 8 inches in diameter , the NB 20 drum chipper efficiently handles palm trunks, branches, bamboo, pine wood, eucalyptus, and sawmill waste . The machine produces uniform wood chips sized 25–35 mm (length) and 7–10 mm thickness , with customization available based on application requirements. Engineered for continuous operation, the machine integrates multiple synchronized motors for feeding, pressing, and discharge, ensuring smooth material flow and reduced downtime. Its heavy-duty construction (approx. 3.5–4.0 tons ) provides excellent stability and long service life in industrial conditions.
